help.context: Hours use Spain time. The report follows the applied filters.

pointsMap.summary: Shows how players earned points during the selected day. Each row is a player and each column is an hour.
pointsMap.reading: The large number is accumulated points at that hour; the + number is the gain. Brighter green means a larger gain, while the large number’s styling highlights higher accumulated scores. The blue Σ column is the player’s daily maximum.
pointsMap.interaction: Select a cell for details or a nickname to open the player profile. Top and sorting change the rows shown. A red diamond marks Red Party; a blue crystal marks other regulars.
pointsMap.note: An empty cell need not mean zero: data may be missing or the hour may be in the future. ! marks a collection outage. Without a new sample, the last known value may be carried forward.

pointsChart.summary: Compares players’ accumulated points over the day. Each player has a coloured line: time runs horizontally and points vertically.
pointsChart.reading: A rising line means more points. A flat section may mean no gain or no new samples: the last known value is carried forward between samples.
pointsChart.interaction: Hover or move the blue slider to see readings at that time. Select a nickname on the left to hide or restore its line. Choose an hour range, show speed, or drag the bottom edge to resize the chart.
pointsChart.note: Lines represent players on the current map. Optional speed is expressed in points per hour and estimated from nearby available samples; it is not another points total.

playerMonth.summary: Shows one player’s activity for the selected month and limit. Rows are days and columns are hours.
playerMonth.reading: The large cell number is accumulated points; the + number is the hourly gain. Brighter green means a larger gain. The Σ column holds the daily result.
playerMonth.interaction: Select a cell for points, gain and speed details. “Full month” expands all days. On narrow screens, the map and lower chart scroll horizontally together.
playerMonth.note: Empty or future hours do not prove that the player was inactive. ! indicates a data collection outage.

profileHours.summary: Helps show which hours the selected player usually earns points fastest. The line shows average speed for each hour across days of the month.
profileHours.reading: Hours run horizontally; speed in points per hour runs vertically. For example, 08:00 combines available speed samples from that hour on different days, rather than points from one day.
profileHours.interaction: Hover or use Tab to select an hour and see its exact value below the chart. Hours align with the columns of the map above.
profileHours.note: The average includes available zero-speed values, but excludes empty hours and collection outages. It can therefore differ from the average in the speed ranking.

speedRanking.summary: Compares players’ point-earning speed for the selected month and limit.
speedRanking.reading: Max speed is the best sample; Avg speed is the average of qualifying samples, in points per hour. Max points is the highest daily result in the period. Bars help compare speeds; the note under the maximum shows the best sample’s gain and duration.
speedRanking.interaction: Select a nickname to open its profile. Top limits the number of players shown. The right columns show registry membership and add/remove actions; the badge by each nickname also identifies the list.
speedRanking.note: The ranking uses only positive speeds measured over more than 20 minutes. Do not directly compare these averages with profile averages, which also include zeros.

speedHours.summary: Compares hourly speed for players in the current Top with everyone matching the filters.
speedHours.reading: Blue bars show average speed for the displayed Top; the warm-coloured line shows everyone matching the filters. Hours run horizontally; points per hour run vertically. Qualifying samples from the month are combined.
speedHours.interaction: Hover or use Tab to select an hour and see both values below. Changing Top changes the bar sample; the line still represents the full filtered group.
speedHours.note: Only positive speeds measured over more than 20 minutes are included. A gap means no qualifying samples. These are average speeds, not point totals or player counts.

densityMap.summary: Shows the days and hours when the selected group earned more points. This measures point volume, not the number of players.
densityMap.reading: Each row is a day and each column an hour. A cell contains the players’ combined point gain for that hour. Brighter green means more points; Σ shows the daily total.
densityMap.interaction: Select a populated cell to see individual players’ contributions for that hour. “Full month” expands all days. Hours align with the lower bars and both charts scroll horizontally together.
densityMap.note: Empty cells can mean missing data or future hours. ! marks a collection outage. A large value alone does not indicate more players: one player can contribute a large gain.

hourTotals.summary: Adds up the point gains for each hour across all days of the selected month and all players matching the filters.
hourTotals.reading: Each bar is one hour of the day. For example, 08:00 adds the 08:00 column of the upper map across all days. Bar height is the total points: a taller bar means more volume during that hour.
hourTotals.interaction: Hover or use Tab to select an hour for its exact total. Select the bar to see players and their contributions for that hour across the whole month.
hourTotals.note: This is a sum, not a daily average, speed or player count. The current month is incomplete, and collection gaps can reduce the available volume.
